channel.title: Frijolito Public News Updates

item.title: Firmly raises $15M Series A backed by JPMorgan and Mastercard, launches Ask Agent in-chat checkout
item.description: Firmly raised $15M from JPMorgan, Mastercard and Samsung Next to connect retailers to AI shopping assistants, and launched Ask Agent for in-chat checkout.
